settings.label: Graphics
settings.help: Standard is the game as on the PS5. Low and Lowest shorten shadows and distant detail and use smaller textures: for a modest processor or graphics card.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: 60 is the game's own. 30 is a steady half rate for slower PCs. 120 lets the game run past 60 where the PC can.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Fullscreen or windowed. In Big Picture mode the game always opens fullscreen.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: The size of the game's picture.

settings.label: Performance overlay
settings.help: The frame rate (and with Detailed the graphics card, processor and memory) in the top right corner. F8 in the game switches it.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: Demon's Souls PC's and the game's logs, to attach to a bug report.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders already built, for less stutter. Only clear it if the picture looks wrong after an update.
